blocks.text: Rock Bottom is the second solo album by the English musician Robert Wyatt. It was released on 26 July 1974 by Virgin Records. The album was produced by Pink Floyd's drummer Nick Mason, and was recorded following a 1973 accident which left Wyatt a paraplegic. He enlisted musicians including Ivor Cutler, Hugh Hopper, Richard Sinclair, Laurie Allan, Mike Oldfield and Fred Frith in the recording.
Mackenzie Ian Anderson, known professionally as phreshboyswag, is a British rapper and record producer. He had previously been a member of American rapper Xaviersobased's collective 1c34.
